proposed_widenings.name: compelled_movement
proposed_widenings.justification: Antipathy forces the creature to use its movement to flee as far as possible; Sympathy forces it to approach as close as possible. Standard Frightened/Charmed conditions do not mandate active movement in a direction — they only impose a directional prohibition (can't approach) or a trust relationship. This is a distinct 'must move toward/away' behavioral override with no v4 atom equivalent.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The Frightened creature must use its movement on its turns to get as far away as possible from the target, moving by the safest route. / The Charmed creature must use its movement on its turns to get as close as possible to the target.

proposed_widenings.name: RepeatSaveSpec.cadence: distance_exceeded
proposed_widenings.justification: The repeat-save escape mechanism fires when the affected creature ends its turn more than 120 feet away from the target — a distance-gated cadence. The current RepeatSaveSpec only supports end_of_target_turn and on_target_takes_damage. A distance threshold variant is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If the Frightened or Charmed creature ends its turn more than 120 feet away from the target, the creature makes a Wisdom saving throw.

proposed_widenings.name: TargetTypeFilter / OngoingTrigger: open creature kind filter
proposed_widenings.justification: The 120-foot area trigger fires only for 'a creature of the chosen kind, such as red dragons, goblins, or vampires.' This is an open-ended text specification, not the closed 14-entry CreatureType enum. The surface needs either an open-text creature kind field or a 'creature_subtype' filter to scope the trigger.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Then specify a kind of creature, such as red dragons, goblins, or vampires. A creature of the chosen kind makes a Wisdom saving throw when it comes within 120 feet of the target.

proposed_widenings.name: SaveSuccessOutcome / RepeatSaveSpec: post_save_temporary_immunity
proposed_widenings.justification: After a successful save against this effect, the creature is immune to the specific effect for 1 minute. No surface vocabulary exists for temporary post-save immunity scoped to a specific ongoing effect. Differs from grant_condition_immunity (permanent, all sources of a condition) and from the general spell-end case.
proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature that successfully saves against this effect is immune to it for 1 minute, after which it can be affected again.

proposed_widenings.name: CastingTime: hours
proposed_widenings.justification: Casting time is 1 hour. The current surface has kind: 'minutes' which could be stretched to amount: 60, but 'hours' is a semantically distinct casting-time category used by several 8th-level and higher spells. A first-class hours variant avoids conflating the two.

notes: The spell's structure is otherwise recognizable as ongoing_effect (10-day timed duration, area trigger around a target, save_gate on entry). The blocking gaps are: (1) the compelled_movement atom — standard Frightened/Charmed semantics are insufficient; this spell mandates active directional movement each turn, which is not in v4; (2) the distance-exceeded save cadence; (3) the open-ended creature kind filter; (4) post-save temporary immunity. Attempting a partial encoding without these would produce a misleading trace — the movement compulsion is the spell's primary ongoing mechanical effect.
